events.title: Chrome Manifest V3 extension uploads enabled
events.summary: Chrome 88 stable enabled Manifest V3 extension uploads to the Web Store in January 2021 — replacing persistent background pages with service workers; mandatory Manifest V2 deprecation came years later.
events.about: Manifest V3 changed how ad blockers, password managers, and dev tools hook into Chrome: extensions became more sandboxed and declarative. The shift sparked years of debate between Google (security, performance) and extension authors (filtering power), and other Chromium browsers inherited the model.

narrative.whyChosen: MV3 redefined what browser extensions could do in the world's most-used browser.
narrative.whyImportant: It forced every extension developer to rewrite for service workers and new permission models.
narrative.problemSolved: Google argued legacy extension APIs were too permissive and hurt battery life and security.

events.title: Payload CMS released
events.summary: James Mikrut, Dan Ribbens, and Elliot DeNolf released Payload CMS on January 13, 2021 — a self-hosted Node.js and React headless CMS.
events.about: Payload gives developers a TypeScript-configured admin UI and auto-generated REST/GraphQL APIs — self-hosted with no SaaS lock-in. It later became Next.js-native, installing directly into the `/app` folder as a full-stack framework.

narrative.whyChosen: Payload brought a code-first, self-hosted CMS to the JavaScript ecosystem.
narrative.whyImportant: TypeScript schemas and React admin UI set a new bar for developer-centric CMS design.
narrative.problemSolved: JavaScript teams wanted headless CMS power without SaaS restrictions or PHP baggage.

events.title: Dario Amodei co-founds Anthropic
events.summary: Dario Amodei co-founded Anthropic on January 26, 2021 with Daniela Amodei and other ex-OpenAI researchers — the company stayed in stealth until its public launch and $124M funding announcement in May 2021.
events.about: Anthropic became OpenAI's primary rival in frontier chat and API models — Claude 2, 3, and 3.5. Amodei's team emphasized constitutional AI and long-context products for enterprise developers.

narrative.whyChosen: Anthropic diversified the frontier LLM market beyond OpenAI.
narrative.whyImportant: Competition accelerated safety research and developer choice.
narrative.problemSolved: Enterprises wanted alternative LLM vendors with strong safety positioning.

events.title: Samsung Galaxy S21 released
events.summary: Samsung began selling the Samsung Galaxy S21 — Snapdragon 888/Exynos 2100 and Contour Cut camera housing.
events.about: The Galaxy S series remained Android's volume flagship counterweight to iPhone. Snapdragon 888/exynos 2100 and contour cut camera housing. Developers testing Android builds routinely validated on Galaxy S hardware as the default non-Pixel reference.

narrative.whyChosen: The Samsung Galaxy S21 continued Samsung's annual Android flagship cadence.
narrative.whyImportant: Galaxy S devices set the hardware bar millions of Android users and developers encounter.
narrative.problemSolved: Android needed consistent premium hardware for testing flagship features each year.
